_doc: Data of the CreativePlan v2 planner. Everything the planner decides that the image model used to decide by itself lives here or in the plan, never as loose prompt prose: gaze defaults per angle, gaze of each pool entry, age parsing vocabulary, role vocabulary. A gaze of 'auto' never reaches the compiler: it is resolved to a concrete mode against this table.

gaze_defaults._doc: single = one person in the frame, multi = two or more. 'none' = the angle has nobody in the frame. Requested by the product owner: single+CAIMENTO camera; editorial/portrait camera; product in focus camera; lifestyle camera or off_camera depending on the preset (see pool_gaze); two or more people interacting -> interaction; gift/reading/play -> interaction; creator selfie camera or mirror depending on the format (see pool_gaze). 'single'/'multi' are chosen by the number of people actually in the frame (0 people is always 'none'), so the gift kit (nobody in frame) resolves to none and the two-person gift to interaction.

pool_gaze._doc: Gaze of each entry of an angles_v2.json pool, by index. Overrides the angle default when the plan picked that entry (the 'preset').

minor._doc: Age parsing for minor detection. A number of years in the label wins; then the persona age_range; then words; then the product (an infant garment implies a child wearer). Unknown is NOT minor, but a primary wearer of an infant garment is treated as a minor.

roles._doc: Role vocabulary read from persona labels, to match a supporting person against a product's semantic_context. Keywords are matched as whole words, accent-insensitive.

labels.sibling: irmão ou irmã da criança, de idade próxima
labels.friend: amigo ou amiga da mesma faixa etária

pose_risk._doc: Deterministic weights for the composition risk stored in the plan (used later to decide QA). people: 2 -> +1, 3 -> +2, 4 or more -> +4 (always high: a 4-person scene is advanced composition and is never suggested as the safe one); a held object -> +1 per object; physical contact between people -> +1. low <= 1, medium 2-3, high >= 4.

pool_held_objects._doc: 1 where the pool entry has the person holding an object (adds pose risk), by index.

pool_contact._doc: 1 where the pool entry has physical contact between people (adds pose risk), by index.
